en: Sepia-toned vintage postcard showing a panoramic view of a small European town nestled in a valley. On the left, a large hilltop fortress complex dominates the scene, with thick walls and gabled roofs surrounded by trees. Below and to the right, tightly packed traditional houses with steep roofs line the streets. In the distance on the right, a large church with a tall, pointed spire rises above the town. Printed German text at the top identifies the location as Leisnig in Saxony and names the castle and hill.
